messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Auto-detect: KV-cache eviction amplification + continuous-batching surge in us-central-2. Impact: elevated 5xx (approx 10%), cont-batch queue depth spikes, increased p99 latency on several models. Paging on-call: @harini (eng-oncall).

harini: Acknowledged. Pulling recent config pushes. @emma / @nikhil please stand by for quick rollback. Noting a noisy shard pattern on kvcache-shard-3. Also seeing an unusual pattern of very frequent small prefix writes.

emma: I'm seeing a config rollout ~6m ago that touched pool selector for inference-burst-us. It set max_num_seqs=256 (was 16) and increased max_batch_tokens to 4096 for the pool. Likely cause: huge number of concurrent short sequences forcing the cache to churn. Going to revert to safe defaults: max_num_seqs=12, max_batch_tokens=800 and limit continuous_batching=true with max_concurrent_batches=4.

harini: Agree. Also bump application-level request timeout to 20s for routes hitting this pool to prevent retry storms. Can you post the ops command you plan to run? We'll coordinate support message after deploy-bot confirms.

emma: Ops patch (applying to pool inference-burst-us):

```
POST /api/v1/pools/us-central-2/config
{
  "pool":"inference-burst-us",
  "max_num_seqs":12,
  "max_batch_tokens":800,
  "continuous_batching":true,
  "max_concurrent_batches":4
}
```

Executing now.

deploy-bot: Config apply started (deploy id=2791240000-hotpatch, sha=3f5c2d). Target: inference-burst-us. Rolling update mode: sequential. Dashboard: https://ops.internal/rollouts/2791240000

nikhil: Pre-change logs from worker-3:

```
[2026-03-15T14:21:03Z] cont_batch_queue len=2300
[2026-03-15T14:21:03Z] evict kvcache shard=shard-3 entries=1200 reason=hot_prefix
[2026-03-15T14:21:04Z] 5xx count window=1m value=9.8%
```

and 60s post-change:

```
[2026-03-15T14:22:07Z] cont_batch_queue len=180
[2026-03-15T14:22:07Z] evict kvcache shard=shard-3 entries=110 reason=ttl
[2026-03-15T14:22:08Z] 5xx count window=1m value=1.6%
```

emma: Telemetry looks promising: eviction rate down ~91%, cont-batch queue back to baseline, p99 latency improved ~150ms. Will keep cont-batching on but with stricter caps — we want batching efficiency without cache amplification.

support-bot: Affected customers detected: BetaFinance (high-volume streams), Shoply (background embeddings). Initial customer-impact: BetaFinance observed ~12% error rate during spike window. Support lead @carla notified and posting status update.

carla: Sent customer-safe message to BetaFinance and internal TAMs. Flagged for a post-incident follow-up. Collecting logs requested by the customer.

harini: Good. Lucas, I'm passing the incident to you in 8 minutes. Please watch the rollout dashboard, and if metrics regress we'll roll back to previous known-good config (deploy id prior: 2791239000).

lucas: Taking handoff early. I'll be primary for next 2 hours. Checklist: (1) confirm config commit exists with rollback button, (2) ensure route timeouts set to 20s, (3) set alert thresholds: cont_batch_queue > 300 and kvcache_eviction_rate > baseline*3 to trigger page. Creating tickets now.

lucas: Created follow-up ticket INC-2791240000-RCA and set severity to Sev-2. Adding tags: continuous-batching, kvcache, config-rollout. Also scheduling a blameless postmortem doc.

emma: One more note: root cause appears to be an automated canary policy that promoted a config from a low-traffic zone without sufficient prefix-distribution checks. Action item: add a canary check for kvcache_hot_prefix_count and max_num_seqs delta > 4x.

nikhil: Also recommend adding a runtime guard: disallow max_num_seqs > 64 for pools tagged as "bursty" unless kvcache_hot_prefix_ratio < 0.1. This would have prevented the promotion.

lucas: Agreed. I'll file a config-safeguard feature ticket and assign to infra-config team. For now, incident state: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Will keep thread updated if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
